sector.description: Only return companies in this sector, as a slug (`technology`, `financial-services`) or as its label in any case (`Financial Services`). Valid values are the `sectorSlug`s returned by `GET /equities/v1/sectors`. An unknown value returns an empty list.

industry.description: Only return companies in this industry, as a slug (`semiconductors`) or as its label in any case. Valid values are the `industrySlug`s returned by `GET /equities/v1/industries`. An unknown value returns an empty list.

sectorSlug.description: Sector id, the same value `GET /equities/v1/sectors` returns. `unknown` when the vendor left the company unclassified.

industrySlug.description: Industry id, the same value `GET /equities/v1/industries` returns.

country.description: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) for the company, as returned by `GET /equities/v1/companies-list` (case-insensitive).

output.description: Map of metric name to its annual and quarterly time series. Keys vary by company and by which metrics are available (for example `revenue`, `holdersRevenue`, `earnings`, `basicSharesOutstanding`).

additionalProperties.description: A single dimension metric, split into annual and quarterly series.

annual.description: Annual data points, newest first. Each item is `[periodEnding, value]`.

quarterly.description: Quarterly data points, newest first. Each item is `[periodEnding, value]`.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (case-insensitive). When set, returns that company's full calendar.

status.description: Only return rows with this `date_status` (case-insensitive). `confirmed` is accepted but nothing produces it yet, so it returns an empty list.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, taken from the earliest `report_date`. Positive integer; values above 20000 are capped at 20000.

cik.description: SEC CIK of the registrant that filed the row. Differs from the company's current CIK for rows inherited from a predecessor after a reorganisation.

event_key.description: `<fiscal_year>-<fiscal_period>`, the row's identity. When the report arrives, its row replaces the estimate with the same key.

date_status.description: `reported`: an earnings release (8-K Item 2.02) was filed. `inferred`: no release that quarter, so the date comes from the 10-Q or 10-K (filing-backed, but weaker). `estimated`: projected from the company's past cadence. `confirmed`: announced by the company; not produced yet.

report_date.description: US Eastern date of the report, from the SEC acceptance timestamp rather than EDGAR's filing date.

report_time.description: `bmo`: before 09:30 ET. `dmt`: during market hours. `amc`: after 16:00 ET. `unknown`: no timestamp, as on estimates. Taken from the SEC acceptance time, not the newswire.

accepted_at.description: Raw SEC acceptance timestamp, in UTC. Empty on estimates.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year the quarter belongs to, named for the calendar year it ends in.

period_end.description: Last day of the fiscal period the report covers. Empty for a release whose 10-Q has not been filed yet, and for estimates projected from one.

source.description: `8k_item_202`: an earnings release. `periodic_filing`: a 10-Q or 10-K, used when there was no release. `cadence_model`: an estimate.

source_form.description: SEC form the date comes from, such as `8-K`, `10-Q` or `10-K`. Empty on estimates.

accession_number.description: SEC accession number of that filing. Empty on estimates.

max_drift_days.description: On estimates, how many days either side of `report_date` the real date may land. 96% of real dates fell inside this range when tested against past reports. Wider for small caps and short histories. `null` on filing-backed rows.

first_published_at.description: When this `event_key` was first published (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.sss`).

revision_count.description: How many times the filing-backed date has moved since it was first published.

previous_report_date.description: The `report_date` before the most recent move. Empty if it never moved.

inserted_at.description: When this row was last written (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.sss`).

country.description: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) for the company, as returned by `GET /equities/v1/companies-list` (case-insensitive).

sector.description: Only return industries in this sector, as a slug (`technology`, `financial-services`) or as its label in any case (`Financial Services`). Valid values are the `sectorSlug`s returned by `GET /equities/v1/sectors`. An unknown value returns an empty list.

industry.description: Only return this industry, as a slug (`semiconductors`) or as its label in any case (`Semiconductors`). An unknown value returns an empty list.
Industry name as the data vendor labels it.

industrySlug.description: URL-safe industry id. Pass it as `industry` to filter.

sector.description: Sector name as the data vendor labels it (not GICS). Companies the vendor left unclassified roll up into `Unknown`.

sectorSlug.description: URL-safe sector id. Pass it as `sector` to the other equities endpoints.

rank.description: Position by market cap, starting at 1. See the note on ranking above.

weight.description: Share of all tracked US equity market cap, in percent.

sectorWeight.description: Share of the parent sector's market cap, in percent.

dollarVolumeShare24h.description: Share of all tracked US value traded in the latest session, in percent.

marketCap.description: Total market cap of the constituents, in USD.

marketCapChange1d.description: Change in total market cap over the latest session, in USD. Reconciles exactly with `priceChangePercentage1d`.

dollarVolume24h.description: Value traded in the latest session (shares traded × price, summed), in USD. Reads low while a session is still open; `volumeAsOf` says when it was taken.

revenueTTM.description: Total trailing twelve month revenue, in USD.

earningsTTM.description: Total trailing twelve month earnings, in USD.

status.description: What an asset row is. A perps market row carries no status. `live` has a value today, which can be 0 when the asset once had a value and every chain now reads a supply of 0. `stale` had a value and has had none for three days; for up to 30 days after its last value its value fields hold that value, which counts exactly where a live row's value would until a new value is read. `lapsed` had a value and has had none for more than 30 days; its value fields are empty and it counts in no total. Only a `live` or a `stale` row carries values. `unpriced` has no price yet and its value fields are empty. `retired` was ended by its issuer or venue, its value fields are empty and its past stays in the charts. `delisted` was taken off by DefiLlama, its value fields are empty and it is counted nowhere.

statusSince.description: Unix seconds. For `stale` and `lapsed`, the last day with a value. For `retired` and `delisted`, the day of the event. Absent when unknown.

statusReason.description: One sentence on why the row was retired or delisted. Present only on a `retired` or `delisted` row that has one.

successor.description: The `id` of the row that replaced this one, as it appears on another row of this list. Present only on a `retired` or `delisted` row that has a replacement.
